title.source: 一朵雲裡約有 500 公噸的水，為什麼不會掉下來？｜原來如此事務所
title.text: A cloud holds about 500 tonnes of water. Why doesn't it fall? | So That's Why

description.source:
夏天下午兩點還大太陽，三點就下大雨。抬頭看到的那朵雲，裡面真的有水，而且一朵普通的積雲估計有大約五百公噸。水比空氣重，它為什麼能留在天上？又怎麼在一個小時以內，變成打在你身上的大雨？

這一集，所長和小問從一朵雲裡的一滴水開始：水蒸氣和雲有什麼不同、雲滴為什麼一秒只掉一公分、一滴雨為什麼要大約一百萬顆雲滴、雷陣雨為什麼偏偏在下午，又為什麼常常下一下就停。最後教你抬頭看三件事。

本集插圖由 AI 生成。數字是常見情況的估算，實際的雲差異很大；每個數字的出處列在下方參考資料。

資料截至 2026-11-03
description.text:
At 2 p.m. on a summer afternoon the sun is blazing; by 3 p.m. it's pouring. That cloud you see when you look up really does hold water: an ordinary cumulus cloud has an estimated 500 tonnes or so. Water is heavier than air, so how does it stay up in the sky? And how does it turn into the heavy rain hitting you in under an hour?

In this episode, the Chief and Little Q start from a single drop of water in a cloud: how water vapour differs from a cloud, why a cloud droplet falls only about 1 cm a second, why one raindrop takes about a million cloud droplets, why thunderstorms come in the afternoon, and why they often stop so soon. At the end, three things to watch for when you look up.

The illustrations in this episode were made with AI. The numbers are estimates for typical cases, and real clouds vary a lot; the source of every number is listed in the references below.

p031: 所以你看積雲，底部常常是平的：那個高度，
剛好是空氣冷到開始凝結的地方。
p033: 只要下面一直有熱空氣送上來，
這朵雲就會一直往上長，長得像一顆花椰菜。
p035: 我們來算一朵普通的積雲。
假設它差不多是一個長寬高各一公里的大方塊。
p062: 沒錯。雲有重量，但它的水碎成數不完的小顆，
每一顆都輕到被空氣托住。
p072: 雲裡的水滴大小不一樣。
大一點的掉得比較快，就會追上、撞上下面比較小的。
p094: 天氣好時那種小小、扁扁的白雲，長不高，
水滴還來不及長大，雲就散掉了。
p100: 很多人都這樣猜。太陽最高是中午，
可是地面和空氣最熱，通常要再晚一點。
p110: 雨落下來，會把周圍的空氣一起往下拖；
雨在半路蒸發，又讓這團空氣更冷。
p118: 空氣夠不夠濕、上面夠不夠冷、風怎麼吹，
只要一個條件不對，雲就長不起來。

lines.source: 所長！所長！我家陽台外面那朵雲，一直往上長。
lines.text: Chief! Chief! The cloud outside my balcony keeps growing taller!

lines.source: 剛剛還白白的，現在下面變成灰色了。
lines.text: It was all white, and now its bottom's turned grey.

lines.source: 那你等一下可能要收衣服了。
lines.text: Better bring the laundry in soon.

lines.source: 可是我想不通。雲裡面，真的有水嗎？
lines.text: But I don't get it. Is there really water in a cloud?

lines.source: 有，而且很多。一朵普通的積雲，大約有五百公噸的水。
lines.text: Yes, lots. An ordinary cumulus cloud holds about 500 tonnes of water.

lines.source: 這件事，你每年夏天其實都看過答案，只是沒有人跟你說。
lines.text: You've seen the answer every summer. Nobody told you, that's all.

lines.source: 先猜猜看：五百公噸，大概是幾頭大象？
lines.text: First, a guess: 500 tonnes is how many elephants?

lines.source: 還有，它會不會變成打在你身上的雨？要多久？
lines.text: And will it fall on you as rain? How soon?

lines.source: 水不是比空氣重嗎？
lines.text: Isn't water heavier than air?

lines.source: 那它為什麼沒有整團掉下來？
lines.text: So why doesn't the whole thing fall down?

lines.source: 這朵雲，今天早上還不存在。那時候天空很乾淨，一朵雲都沒有。
lines.text: This morning, that cloud didn't exist. The sky was clear, not one cloud.

lines.source: 太陽把地面曬熱，地面再把貼著它的那層空氣烤熱。
lines.text: The sun heats the ground; the ground heats the layer of air touching it.

lines.source: 那雲是從哪裡跑出來的？是水蒸氣嗎？
lines.text: So where do clouds come from? Is it water vapour?

lines.source: 很多人都這樣想。不過你先看這個。
lines.text: Many people think so. But look at this.

lines.source: 燒開水的時候，最靠近壺嘴的那一小段，其實是透明的。
lines.text: When a kettle boils, the bit right by the spout is see-through.

lines.source: 白色的霧，要離開壺嘴一點點才出現。
lines.text: The white mist only shows up a little way out.

lines.source: 所以白白的那個，不是水蒸氣？
lines.text: So the white stuff isn't water vapour?

lines.source: 對。真正的水蒸氣是看不見的。白白的，是它冷下來，又變回的小水滴。
lines.text: Right. Real water vapour is invisible. The white is vapour cooled back into tiny drops.

lines.source: 雲也是一樣。它是很多很小的水滴，有時候是小冰晶，不是一團氣。
lines.text: Clouds are the same: lots of tiny drops, sometimes tiny ice crystals, not a gas.

lines.source: 可是天上又沒有水壺，誰把它變冷的？
lines.text: But there's no kettle in the sky. What cools it down?

lines.source: 答案是往上爬。被曬熱的空氣比旁邊輕，會一團一團往上浮。
lines.text: It climbs. Sun-warmed air is lighter than the air around it, so it rises in bubbles.

lines.source: 就像熱氣球？
lines.text: Like a hot-air balloon?

lines.source: 有點像。而且你應該有感覺過：爬山爬得越高，就越涼。
lines.text: Sort of. And you've felt it: the higher you climb a mountain, the cooler it gets.

lines.source: 空氣往上走，周圍的氣壓變小，它就膨脹；一膨脹，就會變冷。
lines.text: Rising air meets lower pressure, so it expands; and expanding cools it.

lines.source: 在還沒有凝結之前，往上爬的空氣，每升高一公里大約冷十度。
lines.text: Before it condenses, rising air cools about 10 °C for every kilometre it climbs.

lines.source: 冷到某個高度，水氣就飽和了，多出來的就會凝結。
lines.text: At some height the air is saturated; the extra vapour condenses.

lines.source: 就像你夏天拿冰飲料，杯子外面會冒出水珠。
lines.text: Like the drops on a cold drink's cup in summer.

lines.source: 杯子外面有杯子給它黏，天上有什麼可以黏？
lines.text: Drops stick to the cup. What do they stick to up there?

lines.source: 好問題。空氣裡有很多你看不到的小顆粒：灰塵、海鹽、煙。
lines.text: Good question. Air is full of specks you can't see: dust, sea salt, smoke.

lines.source: 水氣就是在這些小顆粒上，凝結成一顆一顆小水滴。
lines.text: The vapour condenses on those specks into tiny drops.

lines.source: 所以你看積雲，底部常常是平的：那個高度，剛好是空氣冷到開始凝結的地方。
lines.text: So cumulus clouds often have flat bases: that height is where air gets cold enough to condense.

lines.source: 真的耶，每一朵的屁股都一樣平！
lines.text: It's true! They all have the same flat bottoms!

lines.source: 只要下面一直有熱空氣送上來，這朵雲就會一直往上長，長得像一顆花椰菜。
lines.text: While warm air keeps coming up from below, the cloud keeps growing, like a cauliflower.

lines.source: 五百公噸，是怎麼算出來的？
lines.text: How do you get 500 tonnes?

lines.source: 我們來算一朵普通的積雲。假設它差不多是一個長寬高各一公里的大方塊。
lines.text: Let's work it out for an ordinary cumulus cloud. Say it's a big box, one kilometre long, wide and high.

lines.source: 雲裡的水其實很稀，每一立方公尺，大概只有半公克。
lines.text: The water in a cloud is thin: about half a gram per cubic metre.

lines.source: 可是一立方公里，有十億個立方公尺。
lines.text: But a cubic kilometre is a billion cubic metres.

lines.source: 十億乘以半公克……那是多少？
lines.text: A billion times half a gram... how much is that?

lines.source: 就是開頭說的那五百公噸。
lines.text: The 500 tonnes from the start.

lines.source: 差不多是一百頭大象那麼重。
lines.text: About as heavy as a hundred elephants.

lines.source: 那麼多大象浮在我家上面？！
lines.text: That many elephants floating over my house?!

lines.source: 聽起來很嚇人對吧？你家上面現在，可能也正浮著一朵。
lines.text: Sounds scary, right? One might be over your house right now.

lines.source: 等一下，空氣也有重量吧？
lines.text: Wait, air weighs something too?

lines.source: 有，而且更重。同樣一立方公里的空氣，大約有一百萬公噸。
lines.text: Yes, even more. That same cubic kilometre of air weighs about a million tonnes.

lines.source: 所以那些水，只是混在空氣裡面的一點點？
lines.text: So the water is just a tiny bit mixed into the air?

lines.source: 對。而且這些水不是一大塊，是分成非常非常多顆。
lines.text: Right. And the water isn't one big lump. It's split into a huge number of tiny bits.

lines.source: 一顆普通的雲滴，直徑大約百分之二公釐，比一根頭髮還細好幾倍。
lines.text: A typical cloud droplet is about two hundredths of a millimetre across, several times thinner than a hair.

lines.source: 那它太小了，所以就沒有重量了嗎？
lines.text: So it's so small it doesn't weigh anything?

lines.source: 有重量，它也真的一直在往下掉。只是掉得非常、非常慢。
lines.text: It does have weight, and it really is falling. Just very, very slowly.

lines.source: 你想想看，一顆石頭和一根羽毛一起放手，哪個先落地？
lines.text: Think: drop a stone and a feather together. Which lands first?

lines.source: 石頭啊。
lines.text: The stone!

lines.source: 東西越小，空氣擋它的力量相對越大。
lines.text: The smaller something is, the more the air holds it back, for its size.

lines.source: 小到像雲滴，空氣幾乎把它托住了。
lines.text: Droplet-sized, the air almost holds it up.

lines.source: 一顆雲滴在不動的空氣裡，一秒大概只掉一公分左右。
lines.text: In still air, a cloud droplet falls only about 1 cm per second.

lines.source: 那比走路還慢好多吧！
lines.text: That's way slower than walking!

lines.source: 照這個速度，從一公里高的雲底掉到地上，要超過一天。
lines.text: At that speed, falling from a cloud base 1 km up would take over a day.

lines.source: 而且它還沒掉到，半路就蒸發掉了。
lines.text: And it dries up on the way before it lands.

lines.source: 可是雲一整個下午都在，它也沒有慢慢變矮啊。
lines.text: But the cloud stays all afternoon. It doesn't slowly sink.

lines.source: 因為那朵雲裡面，空氣不是靜止的。還記得那些一直往上送的熱空氣嗎？
lines.text: Because the air in that cloud isn't still. Remember the warm air that keeps rising?

lines.source: 在一朵正在長高的積雲裡，往上衝的空氣，一秒可以走好幾公尺。
lines.text: In a growing cumulus cloud, the rising air can move several metres a second.

lines.source: 那它根本是在搭電梯往上嘛！
lines.text: So it's riding an elevator up!

lines.source: 沒錯。雲有重量，但它的水碎成數不完的小顆，每一顆都輕到被空氣托住。
lines.text: Exactly. A cloud has weight, but its water is in countless bits, each light enough for air to hold.

lines.source: 那水滴要長到多大，空氣才托不住？
lines.text: How big must a drop get to be too heavy?

lines.source: 你淋過的雨滴，常見的大約兩公釐，直徑是雲滴的一百倍。
lines.text: Raindrops you've felt are often about 2 mm: 100 times a droplet's width.

lines.source: 才一百倍？那還好嘛。
lines.text: Only 100? That's not much.

lines.source: 是直徑喔。體積是長、寬、高三個方向都要乘。
lines.text: That's the width. For volume, you multiply in all three directions.

lines.source: 一百乘一百，再乘一百，等於一百萬。
lines.text: A hundred times a hundred, times a hundred, is a million.

lines.source: 一滴雨要那麼多顆？！
lines.text: One raindrop needs that many?!

lines.source: 大概是這個數量級。
lines.text: Roughly that many.

lines.source: 那它們怎麼湊在一起？有人在雲裡捏嗎？
lines.text: How do they get together? Does someone squish them?

lines.source: 沒有人捏，是它們自己撞在一起。
lines.text: Nobody squishes them. They bump together.

lines.source: 雲裡的水滴大小不一樣。大一點的掉得比較快，就會追上、撞上下面比較小的。
lines.text: Cloud drops come in many sizes. Big ones fall faster, so they catch and hit smaller ones below.

lines.source: 撞上去黏在一起，它就更大、掉得更快、撞到更多。
lines.text: They stick, it gets bigger, falls faster, hits more.

lines.source: 像滾雪球！
lines.text: Like a snowball!

lines.source: 很像。這叫做碰撞合併。不過這只是其中一條路。
lines.text: Just like that. It's called collision and coalescence. But that's only one way.

lines.source: 雲爬到夠高的地方，溫度會降到零度以下。那裡會有小冰晶，
lines.text: High enough up, a cloud gets below 0 °C. There are tiny ice crystals,

lines.source: 也有冷到零度以下、卻還沒結冰的小水滴。
lines.text: and drops colder than 0 °C that still aren't frozen.

lines.source: 零度以下還不結冰？
lines.text: Below zero and not frozen?

lines.source: 對，在雲裡很常見。而且在這種地方，冰晶比水滴更會搶水氣。
lines.text: Yes, that's common in clouds. And there, ice crystals grab vapour better than drops do.

lines.source: 冰晶一邊長大一邊往下掉，掉到比較暖的低空，再融化成雨。
lines.text: The crystals grow as they fall, then melt into rain in the warmer air lower down.

lines.source: 所以我淋到的雨，可能原本是雪？
lines.text: So my rain might have been snow?

lines.source: 有可能。夏天長得很高的雷雨雲裡，兩條路都可能發生。
lines.text: It might. In tall summer storm clouds, both ways can happen.

lines.source: 不管走哪一條，重點都一樣：水滴得先長到夠大。
lines.text: Either way, the drops must grow big enough first.

lines.source: 長大了，就會整朵雲一起掉下來嗎？
lines.text: Once they're big, does the whole cloud fall?

lines.source: 你看雲在下雨的時候，雲還在天上，對吧？
lines.text: When a cloud rains, it's still there, right?

lines.source: ……對耶。
lines.text: ...Oh, yeah.

lines.source: 掉下來的，是已經長大的水滴。
lines.text: What falls is the big drops.

lines.source: 重到上升的空氣托不住，就穿出雲底。
lines.text: Too heavy for the rising air, they fall out the cloud base.

lines.source: 這樣的雨滴，一秒可以落下六、七公尺，比雲滴快好幾百倍。
lines.text: Raindrops like these can fall 6 to 7 m a second, hundreds of times faster than cloud droplets.

lines.source: 雲本身還在，只是裡面長大的那些，一批一批離開。
lines.text: The cloud stays put. Only the grown drops leave, batch by batch.

lines.source: 可是我家旁邊的雲，有的下雨，有的整天都不下。
lines.text: But near my house, some clouds rain, some never do.

lines.source: 為什麼不是每一朵都會下？
lines.text: Why doesn't every cloud rain?

lines.source: 這要回到一開始：雲能長多高、裡面的空氣往上衝得多用力。
lines.text: Back to the start: how tall the cloud grows, and how hard the air inside rushes up.

lines.source: 天氣好時那種小小、扁扁的白雲，長不高，水滴還來不及長大，雲就散掉了。
lines.text: The small, flat white clouds of fine days can't grow tall, so they fade before their drops grow.

lines.source: 會下大雨的，是一路往上衝的雲。
lines.text: Heavy rain comes from clouds that shoot all the way up.

lines.source: 雲頂可以超過十公里，跟客機一樣高，甚至更高。
lines.text: Their tops pass 10 km, as high as airliners or higher.

lines.source: 那麼高！那要很多熱空氣才推得上去吧。
lines.text: That high! That needs lots of warm air.

lines.source: 對。所以你猜，一天裡面，地面什麼時候最熱？
lines.text: Yes. So guess: when is the ground hottest in a day?

lines.source: 中午十二點！
lines.text: Twelve noon!

lines.source: 很多人都這樣猜。太陽最高是中午，可是地面和空氣最熱，通常要再晚一點。
lines.text: Lots of people guess that. The sun is highest at noon, but the ground and air get hottest later.

lines.source: 就像鍋子放上爐子，火一開，鍋子不會馬上最燙，要燒一段時間。
lines.text: Like a pan on the stove: it isn't hottest right away. It takes a while.

lines.source: 所以熱空氣往上送得最兇的時候，常常落在下午。
lines.text: So warm air often rises hardest in the afternoon.

lines.source: 那為什麼台灣特別多？
lines.text: Why so many in Taiwan?

lines.source: 因為台灣的夏天還多了兩個幫手：從海上吹進陸地的濕空氣，
lines.text: Taiwan's summer has two more helpers: damp air blowing in from the sea,

lines.source: 還有山。山坡把空氣往上抬，雲就特別容易在山邊長起來。
lines.text: and mountains. Slopes push air up, so clouds grow easily by mountains.

lines.source: 所以下午三點，我家外面那朵雲就……變灰了！
lines.text: So at three in the afternoon, that cloud outside my house... turned grey!

lines.source: 對，它長得又高又厚，陽光透不過來，底部看起來就是灰的。
lines.text: Yes. It's so tall and thick that sunlight can't pass, so its base looks grey.

lines.source: 那為什麼雷陣雨常常下一下就停？
lines.text: So why do thunderstorms often stop so soon?

lines.source: 因為一場大雨，會把自己的引擎關掉。
lines.text: Because a big rain turns off its own engine.

lines.source: 雨落下來，會把周圍的空氣一起往下拖；雨在半路蒸發，又讓這團空氣更冷。
lines.text: Falling rain drags the air around it down; rain drying up on the way makes that air even colder.

lines.source: 你在雷雨前感覺到的那陣涼風，常常就是它衝到了地面。
lines.text: The cool wind before a storm is often this air hitting the ground.

lines.source: 那陣風我知道！一吹就要下雨了。
lines.text: I know that wind! Then it rains!

lines.source: 冷空氣往下灌，把往上送的熱空氣擋掉了。
lines.text: Cold air pours down and blocks the warm air.

lines.source: 沒有熱空氣補進來，雲就慢慢沒力。
lines.text: With no warm air coming in, the cloud slowly runs out of steam.

lines.source: 還記得你問要多久嗎？
lines.text: Remember when you asked how long it takes?

lines.source: 一個單獨的雷雨雲，從長大到散掉，常常不到一小時。
lines.text: A single storm cloud often grows and fades away in under an hour.

lines.source: 不過要說清楚，不是每天下午都會這樣。
lines.text: But it's not like this every afternoon.

lines.source: 空氣夠不夠濕、上面夠不夠冷、風怎麼吹，只要一個條件不對，雲就長不起來。
lines.text: How damp the air is, how cold it is up high, how the wind blows: if one is wrong, the cloud can't grow.

lines.source: 那我要怎麼知道，今天的雲會不會下雨？
lines.text: So how do I know if today's clouds will rain?

lines.source: 所長！它的頭頂還在一直往上冒！
lines.text: Chief! Its top is still bubbling up!

lines.source: 還記得花椰菜嗎？那代表裡面的空氣還在往上衝。
lines.text: Remember the cauliflower? It means the air inside is still rushing up.

lines.source: 這個你抬頭就看得到。
lines.text: Just look up to see it.

lines.source: 現在頭頂變平了，往旁邊攤開！
lines.text: Now the top's gone flat and it's spreading out!

lines.source: 像一個鐵砧。它已經長到撞上一層很難再往上的高度。
lines.text: Like an anvil. It's grown up to a layer it can hardly get past.

lines.source: 啊，突然好涼！衣服都飛起來了！
lines.text: Whoa, it's suddenly so cool! The laundry's flying!

lines.source: 還記得那陣涼風嗎？冷空氣已經跑在雨的前面了。我一開始說什麼？
lines.text: Remember that cool wind? The cold air is already running ahead of the rain. What did I say at the start?

lines.source: 收衣服！
lines.text: Laundry!

lines.source: 好大顆！雨滴是不是像眼淚那樣，尖尖的？
lines.text: Big drops! Are raindrops pointy, like tears?

lines.source: 大家都這樣畫，可是不是。
lines.text: Everyone draws that. No.

lines.source: 雨滴掉得越快，空氣從下面擋得越用力。
lines.text: The faster a drop falls, the harder air pushes up.

lines.source: 小的幾乎是圓的。大一點的，落下時底部被空氣壓扁，像漢堡麵包。
lines.text: Small ones are nearly round. Bigger ones get flat bottoms, like a hamburger bun.

lines.source: 再大，就被扯開，碎成好幾顆。所以雨滴不會一直長下去。
lines.text: Any bigger and they're torn into pieces. So raindrops can't grow forever.

lines.source: 所以打在我手上的，是一顆漢堡麵包！
lines.text: So what hit my hand was a hamburger bun!

lines.source: 衣服都收進來了，雨也停了。真的不到一個小時。
lines.text: Laundry's in, and the rain stopped. Under an hour!

lines.source: 那朵雲跑去哪裡了？
lines.text: Where did that cloud go?

lines.source: 引擎關掉，雲就散了。
lines.text: The engine's off, so the cloud fades away.

lines.source: 打在你手上的每一顆，都是一百萬顆雲滴湊起來的。
lines.text: Every drop that hit your hand was about a million droplets put together.

lines.source: 還記得那些小水滴嗎？它們不是不會掉，是在等長大！
lines.text: Remember those tiny drops? It's not that they don't fall. They're waiting to grow!

lines.source: 原來如此！
lines.text: So that's why!

lines.source: 你家那邊的午後雷陣雨，通常幾點開始？留言告訴我們。
lines.text: When do afternoon thunderstorms usually start where you live? Tell us in the comments.

lines.source: 想一起把生活裡的為什麼找到底，就訂閱原來如此事務所。
lines.text: Want to get to the bottom of everyday whys? Subscribe to So That's Why.
